name: Periodic Full Validation Gate
hypothesis: Running full validation every N successful beads catches cross-package regressions early, reducing total debugging time by more than the wall time added.
change: Set full_validation_every_n_successes to 3. Fast validation (test_touched.sh + vet_touched.sh) continues per-bead. Full validation (go test ./... + go vet ./... + go build ./...) runs every 3 successful beads instead of only at session end.
measurement: Count of regressions caught at periodic full-validation checkpoints vs session-end. Time-to-detection: iterations between regression introduction and discovery. Wall-time overhead per run from additional full validations. Target: >50% of cross-package regressions caught within 3 beads of introduction.
risk: Adds ~30-60s of full validation every 3 beads, roughly 5-10% throughput reduction. If regressions are rare, the overhead may not pay for itself.
